name: Sour Dubb
summary: **Sour Dubb** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] found around 2008 as a clone-only cut of uncertain parentage in Northern California. [[breeder:B.O.G. Seeds|B.O.G.]] later recreated the cross as [[sour-diesel|Sour Diesel]] and [[sour-bubble|Sour Bubble]] for seed release, and the cut went on to parent [[gg4|GG4]].
